class.name: WebRTCEnetSession
class.brief_description: Coordinates a Blazium lobby session that carries ENet over WebRTC DataChannels.
class.description: [WebRTCEnetSession] talks only to an example signaling service (see [SignalClient]). It assigns fake addresses in [code]10.66.0.0/16[/code], installs a per-host ENet socket backend, and returns a normal [ENetMultiplayerPeer] for RPCs and scene replication. Add this node to the tree so it can poll. LAN [ENetMultiplayerPeer] games that never construct a session keep UDP. Native DataChannels need a [WebRTCPeerConnection] backend (webrtc-native on desktop). The WSS relay path still works without it; call [method set_force_relay] from tests.

method.name: close
method.description: Sends LEAVE if the signaling socket is still open, then tears down links, the ENet peer, and the socket. Does not affect other ENet hosts in this process.

method.name: configure
method.description: Sets the signaling WebSocket URL ([code]ws://[/code] or [code]wss://[/code]), game namespace ([code]A-Za-z0-9._-[/code]), and optional bearer token. Rejects CR/LF in any field. Open example servers accept an empty token.

method.name: create_room
method.description: Starts an async host flow. Await the returned [signal session_ready] signal, then assign [method get_peer] to [member MultiplayerAPI.multiplayer_peer].

method.name: get_force_relay
method.description: Returns whether WSS relay is forced.

method.name: get_peer
method.description: The ENet peer created after [signal session_ready]. Null before the session is ready.

method.name: get_room_code
method.description: Short room code assigned by the signaling service.

method.name: is_in_room
method.description: True after [signal session_ready] until [method close] or [method leave].

method.name: join_room
method.description: Starts an async joiner flow. Optional [param display_name] is stripped of controls and ignored if empty or invalid. Does not create the ENet client until the host DataChannel (or relay) is ready.

method.name: kick
method.description: Host-only. Drops [param signal_id] from the room. [param signal_id] must be 1–254, in the room, and not the host.

method.name: leave
method.description: Sends LEAVE and tears the session down. Safe to call when not in a room.

method.name: list_rooms
method.description: Requests visible rooms for the configured [code]game_id[/code]. Await [signal rooms_listed].

method.name: seal
method.description: Host-only. Stops new joins. Existing members stay.

method.name: set_force_relay
method.description: Skip ICE and send ENet datagrams on the signaling WebSocket. For tests and environments without a native WebRTC backend.

method.name: set_ice_timeout_msec
method.description: Milliseconds to wait for a DataChannel before switching a pair onto WSS relay. Default 8000.

signal.name: failed
signal.description: The session could not start or the signaling service returned an error.

signal.name: peer_link_down
signal.description: A remote peer left the room.

signal.name: peer_link_up
signal.description: A remote peer's DataChannel or relay path is ready.

signal.name: session_ready
signal.description: Emitted when the ENet peer is created and transport is ready.

signal.name: using_relay
signal.description: The pair fell back to the signaling WSS datagram relay.

signal.name: using_turn
signal.description: ICE selected a TURN relay candidate. This is not a failure.
